note: Alberta Parks campground in Oldman Dam Provincial Recreation Area, 13 km north of Pincher Creek on Hwy 785, at the Castleview Ridge Estates cottage development below the dam: open, treeless rows with privacy partitions, close to the reservoir and river boat launches. Bring drinking water early in the season (normal water service by the May long weekend). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jul 8, 2026) and shop: 29 full-hookup (15/30 A) sites at C$45, 31-50 ft, no pull-throughs; showers, flush toilets, taps, dump; season corrected to May 15-Sep 30 (was an approximate May 1, derived); reservable on the shop. Riverview kept (river 250-340 m below across open slope). Phone 403-627-1165.
flags: PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 403-627-1165'. No 'Facility Operator' line on the page. Recommend 403-627-1165.

SENIORS LINE: 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.' is on this page. 'Reservations can be made 90 days in advance of arrival date' matches the provincial:AB row. Bookings open February 14.
SHOP: parkId 330307 'Closed through Thu May 06 2027' is park-level (Cottonwood opens earlier); the page gives Castleview May 15 - Sep 30 (2026).
ADVISORY: a bear closure of the Castle River Day Use (since Oct 5, 2026, until further notice) - not the campground; no status.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview - confirmed, marginal): the campground is below and downstream of the Oldman Dam, so the reservoir gives it nothing (the dam and spillway are ~450 m west). The Oldman River tailwater runs 250-340 m south of the site rows, about 35 m lower (DEM 1085 m at the sites, 1050 m at the river), across an open, treeless grass slope crossed by Hwy 785 and a gravel road. A south-facing view of the river across open ground is plausible from the rows; no site is within reach of the water (none tagged 'Near Water' on the shop).

PIN (49.56099,-113.88952): at the north-west corner of the site rows; the rows' centre is ~80 m south-east (about 49.5606,-113.8888); the page's directions point 49.561686,-113.889243 is in the cottage loop ~80 m north. Within tolerance, no move.
